newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Coles Myer says Christmas margins up.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Coles Myer says Christmas margins up.

text.p: Australian retailer Coles Myer Ltd said on Friday its margins on Christmas sales were likely to be higher than last year's dismal December.
Coles corporate affairs director Peter Morgan declined to give any figures on the group's sales performance for this month but said he was cautiously optimistic.
"I'm comfortable with the way we are going at this stage," Morgan told Reuters.
But he said margins on sales were likely to be higher this Christmas due to better inventory management from retailers in an effort to avoid another season of heavy discounting.
"Last year we had a lot of heavy discounting prior to Christmas, whereas this year retailers generally have had a better control on the inventory," Morgan said.
"Last year there was too much stock in the market...and this year retailers have pulled back and adjusted," he added.

Coles' sales were "a little sluggish" early this month but improved in the last few days, Morgan said, adding that the introduction this year of Boxing Day shopping in the stae of Victoria received a very positive response from shoppers on Thursday.
Second quarter sales to January 26 will be announced in the first week of February.
